setup.description: Install and verify purescript, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

version.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

nodeVersion.description: Node.js release or channel to install for the PureScript toolchain.

bunVersion.description: Bun release to install for the PureScript toolchain.

npmVersion.description: npm release to install for the PureScript toolchain.

spagoVersion.description: Spago release to install for the PureScript toolchain.

nodePackageName.description: Native Node.js package selector for BSD toolchain installation.

bunPackageName.description: Native Bun package selector for BSD toolchain installation.
